test_title: PYST 37: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: 8 men working 9 hours a day complete a piece of work in 20 days. In how many days can 7 men working for 10 hours a day complete the same piece of work?
solution:
**Given**

8 men working for 9 hours do one work in 20 days

**Formula used**

(M1times D1times T1)/(W1)=(M2times D2times T2)/(W2)

M= number of persons

D=no of days

T=time taken

W=total work

**Calculation**

(M1times D1times T1)/(W1)=(8times 20times 9)/(1)=1440

7 men working for 10 hours a day is 

(M2times D2times T2)/(W2)=(7times D2times 10)/(1)=70 D₂

So equating these two we get

70 D₂=1440

D₂=20.5714 =20(4)/(7)

**The total number of days to complete the work is** 20(4)/(7)
